{{Top|leg}}
A '''Musicmaker''' was a position within the armed forces of the [[Gacerite]]s. As music was an important part of Gacerite society, each unit had a Musicmaker that played martial music to stir their [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] into a battle frenzy. [[Callet'dira|''Aria Callet'dira'']] in particular was known to site the passions of Gacerite soldiers.
